description: The accept list of the probe phase of `cargo xtask parity script`: probes of `probes/` whose outcome the gate reports as `known-difference` with the reason given here. Only outcomes the port cannot reproduce belong here: a native fault of the oracle (an access violation, a stack exhaustion), a hang of its GUI, a value that depends on the clock, or a divergence `docs/PLAN.md` documents.

accept.a-04.pas: `SetLength` of an `array of string`: upstream reallocates the `TStringList` that holds the strings as raw memory and faults (an access violation); the port raises the array-to-array assignment error of every `SetLength`.
accept.a-21.pas: `SetLength` of a string: upstream's `SetLength(string(TVarData(V).vString), N)` works on the `AnsiString` field of a `UnicodeString` variant and leaves an empty `varString`; the port resizes the string.
accept.e-rec-02.pas: 1000 interpreted calls deep: the oracle exhausts its native stack and the GUI never finishes; the port's call-depth guard raises `Stack overflow` at 128.
accept.e-rec-03.pas: 3000 interpreted calls deep: the oracle exhausts its native stack and the GUI never finishes; the port's call-depth guard raises `Stack overflow` at 128.
accept.e-ordidx-01.pas: a `string` parameter holds the caller's `varUString` upstream, which `GetElement` does not index (only a `varString` is: `Array type required`, `JvInterpreter.pas:6235`), while a local `string` variable holds a `varString` and is indexed (`e-ordidx-06` equal); the port has one string kind and indexes every string (a documented divergence, found by fix-numerics).
accept.e-ordidx-02.pas: a `string` parameter holds the caller's `varUString` upstream, which `GetElement` does not index (only a `varString` is: `Array type required`, `JvInterpreter.pas:6235`), while a local `string` variable holds a `varString` and is indexed (`e-ordidx-06` equal); the port has one string kind and indexes every string (a documented divergence, found by fix-numerics).

accept.f-82.pas: `Format('%*d', [4, 5])` with two `vtInteger`s: the oracle faults reading the width argument (an access violation); the port formats it.
accept.u-06.pas: `Length('héllo')` counts UTF-16 units upstream and UTF-8 bytes in the port (the port's strings are UTF-8 bytes; a documented divergence).
accept.u-07.pas: `Length('héllo')` counts UTF-16 units upstream and UTF-8 bytes in the port (the port's strings are UTF-8 bytes; a documented divergence).
accept.u-08.pas: `Length` of a UTF-8 file read as ANSI: 6 characters upstream, 8 UTF-8 bytes in the port (a documented divergence).
accept.u-09.pas: `Length('Ж❤')` is 2 upstream and 5 UTF-8 bytes in the port (a documented divergence); the `??` of the message log is reproduced.
accept.v-slot-01.pas: a `string` variable holds a `varString` (an `AnsiString`, `VarType` 256) upstream; the port has one string kind, `varUString` (a documented divergence).
accept.v-slot-10.pas: a `string` variable holds a `varString` (`VarType` 256) upstream; the port's one string kind is `varUString` (a documented divergence).
accept.v-slot-11.pas: a `string` variable holds a `varString` (`VarType` 256) upstream; the port's one string kind is `varUString` (a documented divergence).
accept.v-slot-63.pas: `wbVersionNumber` is a `Cardinal` (`varLongWord`, 19) upstream; the port carries a `Cardinal` as an `Int64` (20).
accept.v-slot-69.pas: `Ord(c)` of a `Char` variable reads the character upstream because a typed `Char`/`string` variable holds a `varString` (an `AnsiString`), the one case `Ord` accepts; the port's one string kind is `varUString`, for which `Ord` is the mismatch on both sides (a documented divergence).
accept.v-slot-70.pas: a `Char` variable holds a `varString` (`VarType` 256) upstream; the port's one string kind is `varUString` (a documented divergence).
accept.v-slot-71.pas: a `string` variable holds a `varString` (`VarType` 256) upstream; the port's one string kind is `varUString` (a documented divergence).
accept.v-slot-72.pas: `Ord(s)` of a `string` variable reads its first character upstream (the variable holds a `varString`); the port's one string kind makes it the mismatch (a documented divergence).
accept.v-slot-75.pas: a never-assigned `Double` variable is the `Currency` 0 upstream (`Var2Type(Unassigned, varDouble)` assigns the literal `0.0`, a `varCurrency`, `VarType` 6); the port's is the double 0 (`VarType` 5).
accept.x-011.pas: `'abc'[0]` parses upstream as the string constant followed by the set `[0]` (the `ttLS` case of `Expression`), whose assignment to a string variable passes silently; the port indexes the constant and refuses the index.
accept.x-012.pas: `'abc'[4]`: reading past a string constant faults upstream (an access violation); the port raises `Range check error`.
accept.x-019.pas: `High(5)`: upstream reads the integer as an array record and faults (an access violation); the port raises `Type mismatch`.
accept.x-051.pas: `String(1.5)`: the type cast retags the double's bits as a string pointer and faults (an access violation); the port converts.
accept.x-105.pas: `AddMessage(#0 + 'zero')`: a message with a NUL character hangs the oracle's GUI.
accept.x-106.pas: `AddMessage('a' + #0 + 'b')`: a message with a NUL character hangs the oracle's GUI.
accept.x-318.pas: `SaveToFile('')`: the OS error text of an empty file name (`ERROR_INVALID_NAME` upstream, the port's open error).
accept.x-320.pas: `Free` of a freed object raises `EInvalidPointer` upstream; the port's objects free with their last reference (a documented no-op).
accept.x-347.pas: a `TList` item is a pointer (`VarType` 277) upstream whatever was added; the port's list keeps the value's kind.

accept.x-324.pas: the custom variant type codes are allocated per process in the order of first use (`JvInterpreter.pas:1354-1392`): `sl.ClassType` reads 278 here where `VarType(TStringList)` reads 279 in `r-09`; the port keeps one code per kind (279).
accept.x-386.pas: `Count` of a freed `TList` faults upstream (an access violation); the port's object lives on.
